senses.nuances: 姓名资料记录Zoya为与Zoe相关的名字；这不使它成为马来语中表示“生命”的普通名词。未提供DBP释义，马来文为本条编写说明；official仅沿用指定记录标签，不表示DBP收词认证。以下搭配为教学示例，不声称具有经验证的高频性。不能仅凭本词确定人物、品牌或本人发音。[姓名资料](https://www.babynames.ch/Info/Name/naZoya)

etymology.historical_story: In the Russian naming tradition, Zoya is a form related to Zoe, ultimately associated with the Greek word for life. That history concerns a personal name, not a Malay common noun. The spelling alone cannot establish an individual family's naming tradition, the bearer's background, or the intended reference in this packet. [Name reference](https://www.babynames.ch/Info/Name/naZoya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把Zoya写在朋友的姓名牌上，连记“Zoya dah sampai＝Zoya已经到了”；名字的实际读音向本人确认。
